title: MONSTER V5 Step 4 - Execution Heartbeat + Dead-Man Recovery
scope: Add repository-safe execution heartbeats that bind liveness to the exact workstream, continuation packet and scoped lease; distinguish an expired worker heartbeat from an authoritative async run that is still active; and issue a one-shot dead-man recovery receipt only when the worker is expired and the authoritative run is terminal or absent. Recovery never grants mutation authority: Step 2A and a fresh scoped execution lease remain mandatory.
proof_policy: Exact PR head must pass permanent DevSystem contract and final gate, merge through the single Step-4 PR, merged-main DevSystem proof and terminal receipt must pass, the dedicated authoritative heartbeat/dead-man state ref must be initialized, MONSTER_V5_STEP4 must be content-addressed in the frozen registry, final truth must publish Step 4 FROZEN with START_MONSTER_V5_STEP5, and only the Step-4 scope lease may be released.
